Class StripeWebhookIntegrationHelper

public without sharing class StripeWebhookIntegrationHelper

Helper class for handling Stripe webhook events in Salesforce. Provides methods for saving records dynamically based on replication metadata configuration and executing post-processing logic after record creation.

Group:
    Import Logic

Since:
    06/22/2025

Version:
    1.3


Change Log

  • 06/22/2025 - v1.0 - Initial version.
  • 07/12/2025 - v1.1 - Universal saveRecord() method processes every Stripe event and object, dynamically mapping fields based on replication custom-metadata configuration.
  • 10/25/2025 - v1.2 - New method executePostProcessingMethods(). Method saveRecord() now returns the ID of the saved record upon successful upsert.
  • 11/13/2025 - v1.3 - Method saveRecord() now returns a ProcessResult object.
